title: GORILLA: Silverback Showdown for Forest Feasts | Wildlife Documentary
description:
Witness the immense power of the silverback gorilla as he leads his troop through an intense daily feeding marathon in the dense African jungle. Discover how these gentle giants process dozens of pounds of rough vegetation while defending their territory against rival challengers. Join Animals Planet Space for an up-close look at the high-stakes foraging battles of the world's largest primate.

ANIMAL: Gorilla — today's angle: hunting and feeding.
All footage in this episode is REAL wildlife vid
